# Vibely

> Vibely (vibelydate.com) is a dating app for adults (18+) in Malaysia. A person on the Vibely moderation team checks every profile selfie before the profile goes live, and sign-up needs a Malaysian mobile number (+60). The app is an installable web app (PWA) in English, Bahasa Melayu and Russian. Sign-up is opening in stages: visitors can join the early access waitlist on the home page.

## Ways to meet

- Discover: browse verified people nearby; a mutual like opens a chat.
- Blind Dating: chat with a verified person as an alias, with no photos or names. Profiles appear only when both press Connect; either side can press Pass and the chat ends.
- Blind Dating Night: scheduled evenings when everyone does blind dates at the same time.
- Anonymous feed: posts under a random nickname, or as yourself. Other users cannot see who wrote an anonymous post.
- Duo: team up with a friend and meet another pair; a mutual like opens a group chat for four.
- Live statuses: a short status that people nearby see for 3 hours.

## Safety and privacy

- Every selfie is reviewed by a human moderator and never shown to other users; selfies are deleted after 90 days.
- Messages, media and audio/video calls are recorded for safety and kept for up to 90 days, then deleted. Calls show "This call is recorded". Moderators open recordings only while handling a report, and every access is logged.
- Other users see a rounded distance, never an exact location.
- Block in one tap; reports go to human moderators and the reported person does not learn who reported them.

## Plans

- Free: Discover (100 likes a day), 3 new blind dates a day, text chat, Duo, live statuses, reading and liking the feed.
- Plus: unlimited likes, 10 blind dates a day, see who liked you, photos/voice/video in chat, posting and commenting in the feed, Incognito, 1 profile boost a month.
- VIP: everything in Plus, unlimited blind dates, starting audio and video calls, priority at Blind Dating Night, 1 boost a week.
- No prices yet. Plus and VIP currently come from promo codes and rewards.
